key_catalyst: Alphabet's earnings report with raised full-year capex guidance to $195-205 billion, overshadowing strong cloud revenue and igniting concerns over AI investment returns.
reasoning: Today's earnings misses from Alphabet and Tesla, particularly Alphabet's raised capex guidance and Tesla's profit shortfall, directly challenge the AI spending thesis and have triggered significant after-hours selling. Combined with a sharp oil spike to $96/bbl due to Houthi attacks, reigniting inflation fears and pushing Treasury yields to 4.66-4.7%, the market faces multiple high-severity catalysts that are escalating intraday and likely to pressure QQQ further overnight.
